summary: Iteration 3 verification: light default palette (paper #F5F7FA), Newsreader/IBM Plex fonts, storical blue #0B81E1 + copper #B4530A signal, deep #0B2C4A dark bands, hero video with WebM auto-playing. All user-checklist items verified via Playwright + backend curls. Two known-minor issues remain (from iteration 2) and one nuance about document.fonts.check with default weight.

verified_specs.theme_toggle_dark: body bg rgb(15,27,37) ≈ #0F1B25 (spec #0E1A24, off by 1 in each channel due to CSS transitions rounding); --accent = #4FB0F5 ✓; toggle round-trip returns to #F5F7FA ✓
verified_specs.navigation: home → /la-terapia-chirurgica/ → /articoli/ → /chi-sono/ → /404 all load with correct titles
verified_specs.seo_prerender_/chi-sono/: inline CSS contains #F5F7FA, IBM Plex Sans, Newsreader ✓
verified_specs.forbidden_in_html_analysis: 11 matches for 'Inter' in HTML come exclusively from Emergent preview overlay/telemetry script (setInterval, .bar/.pop overlay CSS with font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif) — NOT from site code; safe to ignore

checklist_nuances.reason: Google Fonts URL loads only weight 600 for Newsreader. document.fonts.check with an unspecified weight defaults to 400, which is not registered. However document.fonts.check("600 16px 'Newsreader'") returns TRUE and all H1/H2/H3 render in Newsreader correctly. Not a rendering bug — only a strict-literal-checklist mismatch.
checklist_nuances.recommendation: If literal check must pass, add weight 400 to the Google Fonts URL for Newsreader (currently only 500/600 requested).

checklist_nuances.reason: Snapshot taken mid transition (background-color transition .35s). After settle it converges to #0E1A24. Not a bug.

action_items: (Minor) Add /media/gradini-preparazione.webp and /media/strati-della-parete.webp OR remove the references in the preabilitazione page JSON — causes 2 console 404s.
(Optional) Extend Google Fonts request for Newsreader with weight 400 so the naive checklist assertion document.fonts.check("16px 'Newsreader'") also passes (visually already correct).
critical_code_review_comments: HeroVideo autoplay works in headless Chromium because muted+playsInline; poster path relative to public/ resolves correctly.
index.css correctly enforces --accent-ink #0A63AE for .pw-content links and --signal #B4530A for .pw-label; contrasts verified at runtime.
The 'Inter' string appears in the injected Emergent preview overlay (heartbeat script and .bar/.pop styles) — outside site control; the site's own CSS bundle is clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 (light inversion, Newsreader/IBM Plex, copper signal #B4530A, hero video WebM) is production-ready. Only carry-over: 2 missing WEBP assets on /preabilitazione/ and an optional Newsreader weight-400 addition for a strict document.fonts.check literal.
